newSubtitle: The document starts as a draft. Its PDF is uploaded afterwards, from its record; nothing shows in Guide Négo before publication.
readonly: You are reading this record without being able to edit it: only document publishing opens editing.
vocabularyError: Document types, themes or COPs could not be loaded. The lists stay empty until they are.

forbidden.scope: Publish Guide Négo documents, or post correction notes on them, across the whole platform
forbidden.scopePublish: Publish Guide Négo documents, across the whole platform
forbidden.description: Guide Négo documents are reserved for platform-wide administrators and experts. An account attached to a single event has no access.

sections.sourceHint: A document is either an uploaded PDF or a link to an outside page, never both.

title.enHint: Optional. Without it, the French title is shown.

cop.label: COP
cop.hint: Optional. The COP the document relates to, one at most.

version.label: Version
version.hint: On creation, leaving it empty gives “1”.

issuedOn.label: Document date
issuedOn.hint: The date the document itself bears, not the date it was published here.

locale.label: Document language
locale.hint: The language the document is written in.

file.label: PDF
file.afterCreate: The PDF can be uploaded once the draft is saved: the file is stored with its document, which must exist first.
file.locked: The file of a published document no longer changes. For a new file, publish a new version.
file.linkFilled: A link is set: clear it to upload a PDF.
file.attaching: Attaching the file to the document…
file.linkSaved: A link is saved: clear it, save the record, then upload the PDF.

link.label: External link
link.hint: The address of an outside page, if the document is not an uploaded PDF.
link.fileAttached: A PDF is uploaded: the document is that file, and the link stays empty.
link.locked: The source of a published document no longer changes. Publish a new version.

supersedes.label: Replaces
supersedes.hint: Optional. The published document this one replaces: readers of the old one will be pointed here.

access.label: Who can read it
access.restrictedHint: Only people admitted to Guide Négo's restricted modules.

rag.label: Offer this document to the assistant
rag.hint: Only takes effect with the assistant, which does not exist yet. Only a document chosen here will be given to it.

error.title: Give the document a French title.
error.version: Give the document a version number.

extraction.title: Extraction
extraction.none: No file uploaded: nothing to extract. A document that is a link does not need it.
extraction.reflowYes: Yes, the text reflows on screen
extraction.reflowNo: No, the document opens as pages
extraction.asIsHint: The document opens as images of its pages, without a readable form. Changes without republishing.
extraction.stopped: Checking has stopped: the state shown may be out of date.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this document?
unpublish.question: It will disappear from Guide Négo right away. Its record stays here, and it can be republished.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.question: The draft and its themes will be erased. This cannot be undone.

result.attached: PDF attached. The extraction is starting.
result.asIsOn: The document now opens as is.
result.asIsOff: The document opens in readable form again.
result.newVersion: New version created as a draft. Enter its version number, then upload its file.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.description: This document does not exist, or it has been deleted.
